gaps: Undocumented private dashboard API; endpoint compatibility may change without notice.
Bearer tokens must currently be obtained from the user's own authenticated dashboard session.
patterns: All shipping API operations are GET-only.
Every resource is scoped by one riderId path template supplied through CAROL_BIKE_RIDER_ID.

novel_features.name: Private ride mirror
novel_features.description: Mirror personal CAROL ride history into local SQLite for dependable offline search and analysis.
novel_features.rationale: The dashboard has no supported export and otherwise requires repeated authenticated requests.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Agents can query a durable personal ride history without keeping a browser running.

narrative.headline: Read and locally mirror personal CAROL Bike workout data.
narrative.value_prop: An unofficial read-only CLI for a rider's own CAROL workout history, with typed commands and a local SQLite mirror.
narrative.auth_narrative: Set CAROL_BIKE_TOKEN to a bearer token from your own authenticated dashboard session and CAROL_BIKE_RIDER_ID to your rider identifier. Never commit either value.

quickstart.comment: Check credential configuration and API reachability.
Preview the latest-ride request without sending it.
Preview a bounded full sync into the local store.

troubleshoots.fix: Obtain a current bearer token from your own authenticated CAROL dashboard session; this private API is unsupported and may change.

troubleshoots.symptom: A command reports a missing riderId
troubleshoots.fix: Set CAROL_BIKE_RIDER_ID to the rider identifier from your own CAROL account.

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for read-only access to your own CAROL Bike workout statistics, ride history, trends, and local analysis. Do not use it to control a bike or modify an account.
